question: On wholly new public-domain archival-film sources from the 2026 AbsoluteCinema benchmark, does the retained P4BS scanner-convolved Thomas spectrum transfer beyond its original uniform-scan cohort, and do phase-sensitive residual statistics reject any Gaussian second-order field as a complete grain model?

primary_source.paper_title: AbsoluteDegradation: A Physics-Inspired Synthetic Film-Degradation Pipeline and Archival Film Restoration Benchmark
primary_source.source_scope: 910-frame reviewer sample drawn from 30 public-domain Library of Congress archival videos; scanner, film stock, process, restoration and transfer functions remain nuisance variables

selection.metadata_only_rule: Enumerate dataset version 6, retain PNG rows grouped by top-level source and clip, keep sources whose lexicographically first clip has exactly ten frames, then select the first four source names and all ten ordered frames from each first clip.
selection.download_destination_rule: caller-owned scratch outside the repository data junction; no project data tree creation

decode.rgb_scalar_conversion: BT.709 coefficients 0.2126,0.7152,0.0722 applied directly to decoded uint8 code values divided by 255; this is an archival-code residual diagnostic, not scene-linear film density

patch_observation.selection_score: RMS spatial gradient of the low-pass patch; deterministic lowest scores with y/x tie break
patch_observation.residual: decoded code scalar minus reflect-mode Gaussian low-pass
patch_observation.normalization: subtract patch mean and divide by population RMS; reject RMS below 1e-6

phase_sensitive.half_split: even versus odd ordered frames within each source
phase_sensitive.interpretation: Phase-scrambled controls preserve each observed patch magnitude spectrum exactly. Stable feature departures therefore test information absent from any Gaussian random field with the same second-order spectrum.

branch_rule.second_order_pass_phase_null: Retain P4BS as a generic cross-source archival second-order reference only; no microscopic, stock, scanner or product claim.
branch_rule.second_order_pass_phase_material: Retain only the P4BS second-order transfer and record that real archival residuals require a non-Gaussian or nonstationary observable before any image-formation claim.
branch_rule.second_order_fail: Close transfer of the exact P4BS spectrum beyond its original same-scanner cohort and seek a new measured response; do not refit on these four sources.

forbidden: fit P4BS or Gaussian parameters on selected archival pixels
change sources, clips, patches, residual filter, features, thresholds or gates after download
treat the selected flat patches as emulsion-only observations
infer film stock, process, scanner, microscopic cloud size or calibrated grain
render product photographs or promote the P4BZ-closed photographic hybrid
write selected payloads under the unavailable repository data junction
claim_ceiling: Independent multi-source archival-code residual diagnostic using a 2026 public benchmark; scanner/process/content/degradation remain mixed, and no stock, microscopy, calibration or product claim is allowed.
